title: Provider selection on successful INIT/KEY_IMPORT/KEY_GENERATE logged at pr_debug only
description: fd.c:802 (INIT success), fd.c:1703 (KEY_IMPORT success), fd.c:2077 (KEY_GENERATE success): provider selection logged at pr_debug. In production (without dynamic debug) a support engineer cannot determine from dmesg which provider was selected for any session. GET_STATE does expose algo and provider fields, so post-hoc analysis is possible IF the caller queries GET_STATE before close(). But if a session has already closed and a bug is being investigated from a log, there is no kernel-side record. Fix: change to pr_info_ratelimited so production deployments have a ring buffer record of which provider handled each session.
close_reason: Fixed in WOLFKM-6vs: provider selection promoted to pr_info_ratelimited
